name: MonarchAiChainOfSteps
title: AiChainOfSteps
wrapsNative: VStack of step rows with ProgressView for the running step, folded into DisclosureGroup with .disclosureGroupStyle(.monarch)
summary: The steps an assistant is working through, as an ordered list that updates live and folds under a summary such as "4 steps" when every step has finished.
whenToUse: Inside an assistant reply, to show the steps of a plan part (MonarchAiPlanPart) while an agent works through them.
whenNotToUse: Not for a person's own multi-step form (use MonarchStepper) and not for a single long task (use a ProgressView).
api: init(_ steps: [MonarchAiPlanStep], details: [String: String] = [:], isCollapsible: Bool = true, startsExpanded: Bool = false, announces: Bool = true, labels: MonarchAiChainOfStepsLabels = MonarchAiChainOfStepsLabels())

struct MonarchAiChainOfStepsLabels { init(label: String? = nil, state: ((MonarchAiPlanStepState) -> String)? = nil, summary: ((Int, Int) -> String)? = nil, started: ((String, Int, Int) -> String)? = nil, failedStep: ((String) -> String)? = nil, finished: ((Int, Int) -> String)? = nil) }

options.name: steps
options.description: The steps, in order, from MonarchAiPlanPart. Update each state (todo, active, done, skipped, failed) as the assistant works.

options.name: details
options.description: Optional detail under a step, such as a result or an error, by step id. Already localised.

options.name: isCollapsible
options.description: Whether the list folds under a summary once every step has finished.

options.name: startsExpanded
options.description: Whether the folded list starts open.

options.name: announces
options.description: Whether starts, failures and completion are announced to VoiceOver. Turn it off when the thread announces progress itself.

states.name: todo
states.description: Dotted circle in the subtle text colour; muted label.

states.name: active
states.description: A small ProgressView in the AI strong colour, or a still filled circle with Reduce Motion.

states.name: done
states.description: Filled check in the success strong colour.

states.name: failed
states.description: Filled octagon in the danger strong colour and the word "Failed" under the label.

states.name: skipped
states.description: Minus circle, struck-through muted label and the word "Skipped".

states.name: folded
states.description: Once every step has finished, a disclosure with the summary ("3 steps, 1 failed", with a failure icon when any failed).

appearance: Icons take the AI strong, success strong, danger strong or subtle text roles by state; labels the default or muted text role. The summary uses the Monarch disclosure group style. All colours are theme roles, so dark and high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The step model is the shared MonarchAiPlanStep, whose not-started state is called todo (pending on the web). The web's detail is part of each step; on iOS it is a details dictionary by step id because the shared step model has no detail field. The web draws a shimmer on the running label; iOS shows the system spinner instead. The web announces through a live region; iOS posts an accessibility announcement.
accessibility: The list is a container named "Steps".
Each step is one element: its label is the step label, its value the state name and the detail, so the state does not depend on the icon or colour.
Failed and skipped steps also show their state in words.
A step that starts or fails, and the end of the run, are announced once; the state at first appearance is not.
The folded summary is a disclosure button with an expanded or collapsed value and a 44-point touch target.
With Reduce Motion the running step shows a still icon instead of a spinner.
edgeCases: Long labels wrap at every text size.
An empty list shows nothing and never folds.
Several changes in one update are announced together, joined by full stops.

examples.title: Running
examples.template:
MonarchAiChainOfSteps(
    [
        MonarchAiPlanStep(id: {{steps.0.id}}, label: {{steps.0.label}}, state: .{{steps.0.state|raw}}),
        MonarchAiPlanStep(id: {{steps.1.id}}, label: {{steps.1.label}}, state: .{{steps.1.state|raw}}),
        MonarchAiPlanStep(id: {{steps.2.id}}, label: {{steps.2.label}}, state: .{{steps.2.state|raw}}),
        MonarchAiPlanStep(id: {{steps.3.id}}, label: {{steps.3.label}}, state: .{{steps.3.state|raw}}),
    ],
    details: [{{steps.1.id}}: {{steps.1.detail}}]
)
examples.code:
MonarchAiChainOfSteps(
    [
        MonarchAiPlanStep(id: "0", label: "Read the attached file", state: .done),
        MonarchAiPlanStep(id: "1", label: "Search earlier notes", state: .done),
        MonarchAiPlanStep(id: "2", label: "Compare the figures", state: .active),
        MonarchAiPlanStep(id: "3", label: "Draft a summary", state: .todo),
    ],
    details: ["1": "3 notes matched"]
)
